description: For the Übersetzungs-Agent: deliver translations for a job as uebersetzungen [{id, text}] (ids from get_uebersetzungsauftrag; any number per call, several calls are fine). When every paragraph has a translation (or fertig=true is passed), the server writes the translated Word file in the original layout, stores it as a document next to the source and sets status 'fertig'. Returns how many are still missing.

fertig.description: Write the file now even if some paragraphs are missing (they stay in the original language).

uebersetzungen.description: Translated paragraphs of the job as [{id, text}]

name: set_uebersetzung
